The full project collection is intentionally **planned**. The published circuits and logic project remains the first culminating stage. Programming, Linux, systems, machine-learning, and applied-AI projects remain **Planned** until their classroom packages are complete.

[See project requirements and the complete pathway in the curriculum roadmap.](../../curriculum/index.qmd#unit-15)

| Project seed | Context | Components | Difficulty | Safety category | Status |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Protected bicycle light | bicycle and transportation | fuse, switch, LED, resistor | introductory | protected extra-low voltage | H01 extension ready |
| USB power monitor | computer and household | connector, sensor, display | intermediate | low-voltage USB | planned |
| Vehicle temperature alarm | automotive | sensor, transistor, buzzer | intermediate | protected 12 V model | planned |
| Accessible reminder device | household and accessibility | timer, LED, buzzer | intermediate | low-voltage battery | planned |

Future project records will add stock, cost, supplier, substitutes, curriculum expectations, estimated time, source paths, and public or restricted access.
